title: Promoters — fiduciary duties and pre-incorporation contracts

content.overview: A promoter stands in a fiduciary position and must disclose profits on promotion transactions.
content.glance: A promoter stands in a fiduciary position and must disclose profits on promotion transactions.
content.study: Promoter is defined in s. 2(69) as a person named as such in the prospectus or identified by the company, or who has control over the affairs of the company, directly or indirectly, as a shareholder, director or otherwise, and in whose advice the board is accustomed to act, excluding professionals acting in a professional capacity. Secret profit is accountable. A pre-incorporation contract is not the company's contract until novation. Misstatement exposure in a prospectus is under ss 34 and 35.
